newsitem.title: USA: USDA ups Algeria feed grain credit allocation.
newsitem.headline: USDA ups Algeria feed grain credit allocation.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture said Monday it had increased Algeria's feed grain allocation under the GSM-102 export credit guarantee program by $1.1 million to $41.1 million.
The increase was specifically for white and yellow corn. Further applications for barley, malting barley, sorghum and oats would not be accepted, USDA said.

Under the reallocation of fiscal 1996 credit guarantees, it made a corresponding reduction of $600,000 in Algeria's allocation for wheat, which fell to $69.4 million, and reduced dairy products by $500,000 to $29.5 million.
The total fiscal 1996 authorization for sales to Algeria under the program remained unchanged at $265 million.
